description: Hi, I would like to make awesome story telling with some friend.
summary: We created a short narrative—a "mini-story"—centered on leveraging the expertise Natalia has gained in sculpture, design, and photography. This serves as a foundation for developing a design using AI tools, resulting in a tone that feels accessible and engaging for both the creator and the reader.
details:
We created a short narrative, drawing on Natalia’s expertise in sculpture, design, and photography. This foundation served as the basis for a design developed using AI tools—an approach that fosters a tone that is accessible and engaging for both the creator and the reader.

Natalia devised a short story centered on an astronaut mission, which is then fleshed out with authentic information sourced from NASA.
